recruit_text.now:
Central Stranglethorn, at a goblin camp, where he runs the cargo hoist, hauling crates up from the river. It's two motions, ten thousand times.

He's aware of the joke and he keeps the job anyway. In the evenings he carves wood, very slowly, very badly.
recruit_text.forward:
To be slow at something. Not good, slow. He's picked woodcarving because it can't be hurried, and he's catastrophically bad at it.

That's the point. He's explained this twice, and neither person understood.

stages.stranger: I'm Jun-seo, a reaper. I'm fast, and I don't talk much. Whatever we do, it's easier than the factory, so don't worry about me.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Busan, near the shipyards. My father carried fish at the market and my mother sewed. I wasn't good at school, so at twenty I went into the yards, and later I was on the welding line, nine years, nights mostly. The same two motions, ten thousand times a night. My body still remembers them.
stages.companion: I sent money home to my parents every month for nine years, without fail. I never married. I told myself I'd start living when they were looked after. I was flipping up my welding shade at the end of a night shift when it happened. The hub for Busan came down far in the north, past the ice. I don't do that sum out loud.
stages.friend: Here's what frightens me. In a fight my body moves before I decide. It's fast, and it keeps us alive, and I didn't choose any of it. That's why I carve. Wood can't be hurried, and I'm terrible at it, and I choose every cut. I want to go north, as far as the road goes, toward the Busan lists. Will you come?
stages.sworn: We couldn't cross the ice. Nobody can, not yet. I stood at the edge for a long time. Then I sat down and carved, right there, slowly, on purpose, for an hour. A small, lumpy bird. It's for my mother, for whenever I can get it to her. I'm back at the hoist now, and I carve every evening, slower and slower. I'm getting a little less bad at it. Gwaenchana, it's okay.

moments.prompt: After the wipe he's sitting very still, looking at his hands.
moments.line: My body did something before I told it to. It wasn't enough, and I'm sorry.

options.text: You kept us alive longer than anyone.
options.reply: Maybe so, yes. I still didn't choose it, but thank you.
I'm already too fast. That's the problem.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to come north with him, as far as the road goes.

options.text: As far as the road goes.
options.reply: Thank you. We'll go slowly. I'm practising slowly.

options.text: What will you do if you can't cross?
options.reply: I don't know yet. Something slow, probably.

lines.bored_warning: We do the same motion again and again, like the factory. I left the factory. Let's go somewhere new.
lines.leaving_good: That was good. I'm going back to the hoist for a while, and my carving. Come and find me.
lines.leaving_bored: I'm going back to the hoist. This is the same two motions, and at least the hoist pays.
lines.after_wipe: We fell down, so now we get up, and we go slower.
lines.wipe_warning: We keep dying in here. I'll finish this run with you, but then I need some days.
lines.wipe_leave: I've finished it with you. Now I'm going back to Stranglethorn for a while.
lines.zone_warning: This place is too strong for us. Even the factory had safety rules. We should go.
lines.zone_leave: I'm stopping here. It's too strong for us. I'll be at the hoist in Central Stranglethorn.
lines.gear_refuse: No, I'd like to keep that. I don't know you well enough yet.
lines.gear_taken: That's okay, take it. It's still easier than the factory.
lines.gear_short: I'm still missing that piece. I'm only saying it once.
lines.gear_upgrade: That's good kit. Thank you, really.
lines.back: I'm back, and I carved a fish, sort of. Where are we going?
lines.send_word: Jun-seo has sent word from Central Stranglethorn. He's ready to come out again.
lines.walkout_talk: I left angry, and I'd like to explain slowly. Then you can tell me yours.
lines.neglect: You were gone a long time. I carved a lot of bad birds.
lines.on_break: Jun-seo is back at the cargo hoist in Central Stranglethorn. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.
lines.quest_abandoned: We said we'd do that and we didn't. I don't like leaving a job half done.

dungeon_clear.text: Closed spaces don't bother me. I welded inside hulls nobody had opened yet.

boss_down.text: Good, it's down. Check the ground under you before you move.

zone_arrive.text: Night shift suited me. The steel moves less when it's cool.

town_arrive.text: My father carried fish at the market before the sun came up. I can smell a fish market from here, and it makes me hungry.
